title: Automated Scoring for Reading Comprehension via In-context BERT Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the average prediction bias (the difference between the model's predicted score and the actual human score) for different gender groups. The evaluation compares performance when gender information is omitted versus explicitly prepended to the input prompt (e.g., 'score this answer written by a Female...').

Calculating the average prediction bias (the difference between the model's predicted score and the actual human score) across various racial and ethnic student groups. The evaluation compares performance when ethnicity information is omitted versus explicitly prepended to the input prompt (e.g., '...Asian student').
